ms.promise:
The external audit team will review our secondary support systems including:
・Alert and monitoring systems for data source endpoints (this is a system that checks that data sources are active, healthy, and provide accurate input values for an oracle network ... example: a Cardano DEX might provide corrupted data for the ADA/USD price feed (real world example) where the price never updates for 10+ cycles because they are not updating correctly. Although the same value could be a possible scenario, it is unlikely, so our alert and monitoring system will flag our team to investigate potential outages in the future due to corrupted data collected at the node operator level)
・Alert and monitoring systems for node operators (Node operators are the validators that call API / data end points then find median values before posting them on the Cardano blockchain as input for Charli3's oracle aggregation on-chain function; this alert and monitoring system checks that node servers are online, posting values, have a healthy status, have not been punished a certain amount to deem them not eligible to participate, and etc.; this system pro-actively seeks potential outages of data feeds before the
